messages:
ida: New idea: 30-min "Launchpad Micro" webinar — 3 x 7-min tactical demos + 10-min Q&A. Focus on copyable playbooks (latency, cost, embeddings). Need speaker list + 1-sentence abstracts by EOD Friday.
sam: Love it. Title option: 'Launchpad Micro: Inference Playbooks'. Ask reg form to capture primary_interest (benchmarks/quant/embeddings) + team_size.
marco: I'll do the customer demo (embedding search). Maya is OK to join and can provide a 30s clip as fallback. Wed rehearsal 9am PT preferred.
ava: Ops: absolutely prepare fallback assets — 90s recorded clip + cached outputs for each demo. We'll test streaming capture vs full responses in tech-check.
ops-bot: calendar: "Launchpad Micro  Tech check + Rehearsal" scheduled Wed 2024-05-15 09:00 PT link: https://calendar.internal/evt/5512
ida: Seed abstracts (please expand to 1-2 sentences):
- Benchmarks: "Trim token spend 3x by combining adaptive batching + prefix caching, without p99 regressions."
- Quant: "Safe quantization: tests, rollback signals, and human-in-the-loop checks."
- Embeddings: "Embedding-first search: how a customer hit ~50ms answers with model routing."
sam: Lead routing: hidden field interest=benchmarks|quant|embeddings. Route benchmarks -> SDR-A, others -> SDR-B. Add utm=launchpad_micro on reg link. Export segmented list daily.
marco: Run-of-show (tight):
00:00 Host intro (ida)
02:00 Demo 1 - Benchmarks (sam)
09:00 Demo 2 - Quant & QA (sam)
16:00 Demo 3 - Customer (marco + maya)
23:00 Live Q&A (panel)
30:00 Close + CTAs (trial / request demo)
ida: Need 3-line pivot scripts for each demo + 5 validation prompts per demo for rehearsal. Ops: also capture separate audio tracks and record locally.
ava: I'll upload a 5-row test vector CSV + fallback clips to shared drive by Thu EOD. Also will prepare a short ops-runbook for fallback play (who hits the clip, who narrates).
maya: Confirmed — I'll send a 30s clip and a short blurb by Thu and join rehearsal Wed 9am PT.
pr: Heads-up: we'll prep a 2-min highlight reel for on-demand; need timestamps from ops within 24h.
ida: Good. Marketing to draft reg page + two subject lines for A/B test. Also add conversion events: webinar_registered, demo_played, lead_assigned.
ops-bot: reminder: tech-check scheduled 48h before event.
sam: I'll also build a tiny post-webinar drip: highlight + trial coupon + enterprise contact.
ida: Thanks all — please drop speaker abstracts into the doc by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
